content.title: Nobody's Isle
content.theme: The Odyssey's Cyclops restaged on an Aegean shore: a shipwrecked crew, a smoking cave, and a captain whose only weapon is his wits.
content.premise: Your galley rides at anchor a spear-throw off the sand of a small green island, its crew around a driftwood fire with no appetite for exploring. Above the meadows a single thread of smoke curls from a cave in the mountain's face, where something far larger than a man keeps its flock. You have no spear worth the name; before this island is done with you, cleverness is the only blade you will carry.

boundary.message: The surf drags at your legs and hauls you back toward the sand.
